reviewNotes: Reviewed all 117 distinct speech keys against every question, answer and Japanese explanation in all 20 cards of data/pages50.json. Checked contextual topic は → わ, directional へ → え, object を → お. Preserved lexical はんだい, はんぎり, はさき, 刃 は, はくへん, はさい, はざわり, はんのう, はなし, はやい, はやめ, はいり and lexical へんか, へんしょく. Checked ゆきひらなべ, おひつ, おとしぶた, すりこぎ, くしめ, ほんがれぶし, きぶた, たまごやきき, せいろ, さいばし, ねつおうとう, ねつようりょう, じょうきげん, ひどおり and きゅうしつ against explicit source furigana. Converted loanwords to hiragana while preserving long-vowel marks and punctuation; supplied terminal punctuation. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
